title: Tech Trends 2013: Elements of postdigital
notes: Preface: 'we’ve selected ten topics that have the potential to impact businesses over the next 18 to 24 months.' Ten trends in two categories, Disruptors (1-5) and Enablers (6-10). Each chapter also has a 'Flying Car Future' section that 'takes a provocative view into where the trend may be headed in Horizon 3 – and beyond'; those sections are not recorded as separate entries. Quotes are from the 'At a Glance' summaries. Read from the Wayback Machine copy of the Deloitte Global PDF. Issue #29 notes Envisioning also holds a copy of this edition. Published month not stated.

entries.label: CIO as the Postdigital Catalyst
entries.quote: When CIOs harness the convergence of the five postdigital forces, they can change the conversation from systems to capabilities and from technical issues to business impact.
entries.subject: CIO role

entries.label: Mobile Only (and beyond)
entries.quote: The next wave of mobile may fundamentally reshape operations, businesses and marketplaces – delivering information and services to where decisions are made and transactions occur.
entries.subject: Enterprise mobility

entries.label: Social Reengineering by Design
entries.quote: Social reengineering can fundamentally transform how work gets done, but it isn’t just a “project.” It’s a strategy.
entries.subject: Enterprise social platforms

entries.label: Design as a Discipline
entries.quote: Driven by consumer experience, intuitiveness and simplicity are moving from IT aspirations to enterprise mandates.
entries.subject: Design and user experience in the enterprise

entries.label: IPv6 (and this time we mean it)
entries.quote: While there’s no drop dead date for IPv6, the final IPv4 address blocks have already been allocated.
entries.subject: IPv6

entries.label: Finding the Face of Your Data
entries.quote: By combining human insight and intuition with machine number-crunching and visualization, companies can answer questions they’ve never answered before.
entries.subject: Data visualization and analytics

entries.label: Gamification Goes to Work
entries.quote: This trend has moved beyond hype and is already demonstrating business value.
entries.subject: Gamification

entries.label: Reinventing the ERP Engine
entries.quote: ERP is no stranger to reinvention, overhauling itself time and again to expand functionality. But the underlying engine has remained fairly constant. That’s now changing.
entries.subject: Enterprise resource planning (ERP)

entries.label: No Such Thing as Hacker-proof
entries.quote: You’ve either been breached – or you soon will be.
entries.subject: Cybersecurity

entries.label: The Business of IT
entries.quote: Fragmented processes and systems can prevent IT from effectively delivering on the changing demands of the business.
entries.subject: IT management systems (business of IT)
